spaw.translation: abbr. 普鲁士科学院学报

spawn.definition:
n. the mass of eggs deposited by fish or amphibians or molluscs
v. lay spawn
spawn.translation:
n. (鱼)卵, 产物
vt. 产卵, 酿成, 大量生产
vi. 产卵, 大量生产

spawned.definition:
v call forth
v lay spawn
spawned.translation: v. 孵出；引起（spawn的过去分词）

spawner.definition: n. a female fish at spawning time
spawner.translation: 产卵鱼（或虾、蟹等）, 已成熟的雌鱼

spawners.definition:
plural of spawner
n. a female fish at spawning time
spawners.translation: (spawner 的复数)  产卵鱼（或虾、蟹等）, 已成熟的雌鱼

spawning.definition:
v call forth
v lay spawn
spawning.translation: v. 播种, 产卵；大量生成（spawn的现在分词）

spawnings.definition:
plural of spawning
v call forth
v lay spawn
spawnings.translation: (spawning 的复数) v. 播种, 产卵；大量生成（spawn的现在分词）

spawns.definition:
n the mass of eggs deposited by fish or amphibians or molluscs
v call forth
v lay spawn
spawns.translation:
n. （鱼、蛙等的）子, 卵( spawn的名词复数 )
v. （鱼、蛙等）大量产（卵）( spawn的第三人称单数 ); 大量生产
